name: Sword of Wounding

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: Once a turn, a hit wounds: 1d4 Necrotic per wound at the start of each of its turns until a DC 15 Con save ends them.
text: Damage from this magic weapon can't be undone by magic, regeneration or anything else; those Hit Points come back only with a Short or Long Rest. Once per turn, you can wound a creature you strike with it. As each of its turns begins, a wounded creature takes 1d4 Necrotic damage per wound, then rolls a Constitution saving throw against DC 15; success closes every such wound on it. Instead, the creature itself or someone no more than 5 feet away from it can spend an action on a Wisdom (Medicine) check against DC 15, which ends the wounds on a success.
